# ZAYVORA Health OS™ — Complete Product Overview

## Brand & Philosophy
**Brand:** ZAYVORA Health™  
**Tagline:** Ancient Wisdom. Modern Science. Intelligent Care.  
**Core Mission:** Unifying classical Unani Greco-Arab medicine with contemporary biomedical intelligence, algorithmic clinical decision support, and strict statutory patient safety governance.

## Executive Summary
ZAYVORA Health OS™ is an enterprise-grade, multi-application healthcare operating system designed to bridge the gap between traditional holistic systems of medicine (AYUSH / Unani Tibb) and modern evidence-based clinical workflows. The platform operates across six core user domains: Patients, Doctors/Hakeems, Multi-Specialty Clinics, Compounding and Retail Pharmacies, Research Institutions, and Regulatory Administrators.

## Architectural Pillars
1. **Classical Unani Intelligence:** 10-Ajnas constitutional Mizaj assessment, 12-axis functional organ cross-talk, Asbab Sittah Zaruriyyah (Six Essential Pre-requisites of Health), and classical formulation rules (Juz-e-Azam, Muin, Musleh, Badal).
2. **Contemporary Biomedical Epistemology:** Multi-analyte laboratory integration, inflammatory marker cross-talk (e.g., hs-CRP, ESR, Uric Acid, HbA1c, eGFR), and ICD-11 / SNOMED-CT clinical coding.
3. **Clinical AI & Ambient Intelligence:** Polyglot ambient acoustic scribe (supporting Urdu, Hindi, English, and regional dialects) and Hakeem Sahab™ Clinical Copilot. All AI outputs are non-delegable and strictly advisory (`safe_to_lock = False`), requiring manual review and cryptographic sign-off by a licensed clinician.
4. **Deterministic Safety Firewall:** Automated screening for red flag emergency symptoms, contraindications, and Schedule E(1) statutory poisons (*Suranjan Talkh*, *Kuchla*, *Bhilawa*), strictly blocking dispensing without verified Mudabbar detoxification.
5. **Standards Compliance:** HL7 FHIR R4, ABDM (Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission) Milestone 1-3, 21 CFR Part 11 cryptographic audit logging with SHA-256 Merkle chaining, and WHO-UMC / ICH E2B pharmacovigilance.
